title: Projection Invariants and Variant Carriers

basis.scope: Define invariant and variant carriers for projection from the Core Expression into a domain-specific completed RT. The basis is additive and documentary, reusing the applied Patch 048 projection witnesses and the earlier rebinding witness family without modifying RT_core or asserting universal projection semantics.

core_rule.statement: Projection from the Core Expression into a domain-specific RT preserves closure eligibility and identity continuity only under explicit projection typing, while residue, orientation, state, and scale-expression may vary by receiving domain.

preserved_under_projection: domain-typed RT completeness after closure verification

forbidden_inference: pi_x(Core Expression) -> RT_x does not imply pi_y(Core Expression) -> RT_y preserves the same residue.
Projection does not imply metric equivalence across domains.
Projection does not imply slot-role symmetry.
Projection does not imply identity with the Core Expression.

relationship_to_prior_patches.047: A|E distinction preserves asymmetry rather than symmetry.
relationship_to_prior_patches.048: RT may be represented as a domain-specific projection of the Core Expression.
relationship_to_prior_patches.049: Defines candidate invariants and variant carriers under projection.

required_repo_changes.description: Add the projection trace that identifies preserved and transformed carriers under one witness.
Add the variant table that classifies preserved and transformed quantities.
Add the counterexample that prevents overbroad preservation claims.

success_criteria: Shows at least one projected RT where identity continuity is preserved.
Shows at least one variant carrier changing under domain projection.
Includes one counterexample preventing overbroad preservation claims.
Does not update textbook surfaces until gate accepts.
non_claims: Does not prove all RTs derive from the Core Expression.
agent_instruction: Create PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_049 as PROPOSED only. Add provenance to applied PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_048 and its projection execution artifacts. Use additive mode. Do not apply until the execution surface exists and patch-gate returns apply.
